shape: Study metadata, three treatment identities, frozen source hashes, split manifests, evidence-role policy. Existing runner and unchanged oracle execute tasks.

confirmation.authorship: Independent heldout author. Setup author must not read private case contents.
confirmation.readiness: Template planning only. Assemble private manifest before strict preparation.

evidence_roles.primary: Per-answer strong executable script assertion result from unchanged oracle. Report separate false-green and healthy-control failures.
evidence_roles.secondary: One soft explanation judge assertion per answer. No judge panel.
evidence_roles.diagnostic: soft skill_invoked assertions for all three arms. Loading earns no behavior credit.
evidence_roles.validity: Reject wrong snapshot, wrong fixture or prompt, missing output, task-count mismatch, treatment contamination, or exposure failures separately; do not score as behavior improvement. Skill invocation receipt alone does not prove mounted bytes were read.

inconclusive: Only secondary or exposure scores separate.
decision_policy.candidate_signal: Current arm improves primary oracle outcomes against both previous and absent arms without rejection. Human review required before confirmation or promotion.
limits: Tiny targeted set is not broad efficacy proof.
No saved verify-commands model runs establish a measured weakness or lift.
Existing unslop evidence does not establish separation for this study.
The oracle tests the returned shell artifact under /bin/sh and cannot attest shell state in earlier tool invocations.
The outer /bin/sh can launch nested Bash. The study requires model-free controls to verify Bash availability and nested-Bash exit preservation.
